part5.q: Having completed the quarterly report, the manager ____ the team to prepare for the upcoming audit.
part5.explain: ‘Having completed…’은 과거 완료형 분사구문이며, 주절도 과거 시제로 일치해야 하므로 ‘asked’가 정답이다.

part5.q: The new software, ___ by the IT department, improves data processing speed by 30%.
part5.explain: ‘by the IT department’ 뒤에 과거분사가 와야 하므로 ‘developed’가 올바른 선택이다.

part5.q: ___ the deadline approaching, many employees stayed late to finish their tasks.
part5.explain: ‘With the deadline approaching’은 현재분사구문으로, ‘With’를 사용해 전체 문장을 연결한다.

part5.q: The conference, ___ in Tokyo last year, will be held in Seoul this time.
part5.explain: ‘held in Tokyo last year’는 과거분사 형태가 필요하므로 ‘held’가 정답이다.

part5.q: ___ the new policy, the company expects to reduce expenses significantly.
part5.explain: ‘Implementing the new policy’는 현재분사구문으로, 주절의 동작이 앞으로 일어날 것을 나타낸다.

passage.title: Upcoming International Conference Schedule
passage.body:
Subject: International Conference 2024 – Schedule and Details
From: kim.jae@globalcorp.com
To: allstaff@globalcorp.com
Date: October 5, 2024

Dear Team,

We are pleased to announce the schedule for the International Conference 2024, which will take place in Seoul from November 12 to November 15. Please review the agenda below and mark your calendars accordingly.

Conference Schedule
November 12 – 09:00–10:30 Opening Remarks and Keynote Address
November 12 – 11:00–12:30 Session A: Market Trends in Asia
November 12 – 14:00–15:30 Session B: Digital Transformation Strategies
November 13 – 09:00–10:30 Workshop 1: Data Analytics
November 13 – 11:00–12:30 Workshop 2: Cloud Computing
November 14 – 09:00–12:00 Panel Discussion: Future of Global Trade
November 15 – 09:00–10:00 Closing Ceremony

Please confirm your attendance by replying to this email by October 20. For any questions, contact the event coordinator, Lee Min-ho, at minho.lee@globalcorp.com.

We look forward to a productive and engaging conference.

Best regards,
Jae Kim
Event Manager

questions.q: What is the main purpose of this email?
choices: To announce a new product launch
To provide the schedule for an upcoming conference
To inform about a policy change
questions.explain: 이메일은 회의 일정을 안내하고 참석을 요청하는 것이 목적이므로 B가 정답이다.
questions.evidence: We are pleased to announce the schedule for the International Conference 2024, which will take place in Seoul from November 12 to November 15.

questions.q: On which day will the Panel Discussion be held?
questions.evidence: November 14 – 09:00–12:00 Panel Discussion: Future of Global Trade

questions.q: By what date should employees confirm their attendance?
questions.explain: 이메일 본문에 참석 확인 마감일이 ‘October 20’이라고 적혀 있다.
questions.evidence: Please confirm your attendance by replying to this email by October 20.

questions.q: Who should be contacted for questions about the event?
questions.explain: 문의 담당자는 ‘Lee Min-ho’이며, 이메일 주소도 함께 제공된다.
questions.evidence: For any questions, contact the event coordinator, Lee Min-ho, at minho.lee@globalcorp.com.

vocab.tip: Part 7은 문서 종류(이메일·공지·광고)를 먼저 파악하면 '목적' 문제가 바로 풀립니다.
